title: Windows Radeon YOLO Golden Path acceptance contract (R21 harness / R22 gates)
description: Machine-checkable gate definitions. A gate is PASS only when its required evidence record exists, validates against the common evidence schema, and its embedded assertions recompute to the claimed verdict (generate_report.py full enforces the false-PASS rules).

G0_provenance.pass_condition: official channel URL set + every wheel SHA256 recorded + loaded MIOpen.dll identity recorded + no workaround detected (else class downgrades to ENGINEERING_REFERENCE) + build lineage traceable (PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE blocks OFFICIAL_STABLE)
G0_provenance.r21_note: on the engineering-reference stack this gate classifies, it does not pass officially

G1_miopen_nostl.pass_condition: BatchNorm2d(100) (20,100,35,45) fwd+bwd finite under VCToolsInstallDir redirect + empty INCLUDE + fresh cache, NO HIPRTC shim; marker alone is insufficient
G1_miopen_nostl.pre_fix_expected: HIPRTC_ERROR_COMPILATION(6) / 'type_traits' file not found / miopenStatusUnknownError → OFFICIAL_PRE_FIX_EXPECTED_FAIL

G2_torch_torchvision_gpu.pass_condition: all 9 gates PASS on GPU; no CPU fallback; torchvision.ops.nms failure with hipErrorInvalidDeviceFunction classifies AMD_PACKAGE_DEPENDENCY_MISSING (not a MIOpen regression)

G3_ultralytics_cli.pass_condition: exact command 'yolo train model=yolo26n.pt data=coco8.yaml epochs=1 device=-1', released ultralytics==8.4.214 (non-editable), genuine GPU via device=-1, AMP recorded, epoch+val complete, last.pt+best.pt hashed, exit 0

G4_optimizer_update.pass_condition: ≥1 real optimizer step + named_parameters delta > 1e-9 on ≥1 tensor (buffers excluded) + all finite + per-step scaler history recorded; harness-disclosed as supplementary

G5_checkpoint_resume.pass_condition: checkpoint complete → controlled interrupt → NEW process resume=True → epoch continuity → best.pt GPU inference in third process; INCONCLUSIVE sub-gates allowed only where API state is not exposed

G6_gfx1100_physical.pass_condition: G1..G5 physically executed on gfx1100 hardware with per-record gpu_name + gfx_target provenance

G7_gfx1151_physical.pass_condition: G1..G5 physically executed on gfx1151 hardware (Radeon 8060S) — never fabricated; portable runner identical bytes

G8_reliability.pass_condition: ≥10 independent training processes per arch, cold+warm cache classes both covered (fresh USERPROFILE = cold; process restart alone is NOT cold), zero unexplained anomaly-family failures

G9_clean_windows.pass_condition: CLEAN_WINDOWS_INSTALL requires a newly installed / demonstrably clean controlled Windows image: no historical ROCm caches, no host MSVC STL dependency, no DLL substitution, no HIPRTC injection, no dev checkout shadowing, no PYTHONPATH overrides; on a development host this gate is BLOCKED_INFRASTRUCTURE

verdicts.full_golden_path: WINDOWS_RADEON_YOLO_GOLDEN_PATH_PASS requires G0..G9 ALL PASS on OFFICIAL_STABLE runtime class
verdicts.candidate_ceiling: dev/nightly/rc candidates can earn *_CANDIDATE_PASS only; functional PASS never promotes channel class
